Listeners can access 'The Warning' on any platform where they normally get podcasts.

assumptions.text: Audience members value insider or alternative perspectives beyond mainstream media.
The speaker's personal endorsement enhances the credibility and appeal of their new podcast.
Credibility is tied to being associated with both fame and authenticity (known vs. unknown experts).
Public intellectual engagement requires self-presentation as approachable yet authoritative.
Trust is built through transparency about content scope and guest diversity.
Audiences seek depth and nuance over surface-level political commentary.
Media consumption habits are assumed to be consistent across platforms and users.
A sense of exclusivity or discovery motivates listenership of niche or less-publicized content.
